content.text:
Now I have a clear picture. Here's what's happening:

**`plugin:claude-mem:claude-mem-search`** — The server binary itself responds correctly to MCP handshakes (I tested it), so this failure is likely transient. It starts fine when invoked directly.

**`serena`** — The config uses `uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena`, which tries to fetch/verify the package from GitHub on every startup. It's timing out (30s limit). The fix is to install serena as a persistent tool so it doesn't need a network fetch each time.

For serena, the fix is:
```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/oraios/serena
```
Then update the config to just call `serena` directly instead of `uvx --from git+...`.

Do you want me to apply that fix? Before I do, a couple of questions:
1. Do you actually use serena? (It's an AI coding assistant — if you're not using it, we could just remove the config instead.)
2. For claude-mem — since it works when tested manually, I'd suggest just restarting Claude Code to clear the transient failure. Want me to do anything specific to investigate further?
